# Anthony Pye

## Overview

- **Age:** School-age child (around seven to nine years old during volumes 1–4)  <sub>[v2 c1 P46](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0046), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c8 P28](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0028)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c18 P35](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0035), [v2 c1 P46](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0046)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v2 c12 P52](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0052)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v2 c1 P46](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0046)</sub>
- **Role:** School pupil at Avonlea School  <sub>[v2 c1 P46](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0046), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004)</sub>

## Appearance

Anthony is a small, wiry boy with a dark, sullen little face and black eyes. He is known for his insolent swagger and scornful expressions in school.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c8 P28](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0028), [v2 c12 P1](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0001), [v2 c12 P28](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0028)_

## Personality

Anthony is an independent, rebellious, and mischief-loving boy who holds girl teachers in contempt. He displays a sullen, defiant demeanor toward authority, often mocking his teachers or trying to provoke them. Despite his stubbornness, he responds to physical discipline and ultimately develops a grudging respect for those who stand up to him.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 c5 P27](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0027), [v2 c8 P28](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0028), [v2 c12 P28](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0028), [v2 c12 P50](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0050)_

## Goals

- To defy and mock girl teachers whom he considers useless  <sub>[v2 c5 P27](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0027), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005)</sub>

## History

Anthony Pye comes to Avonlea as an orphan to live with his uncle, Mr. George Pye. When Anne Shirley takes over Avonlea School, Anthony quickly sets himself against her, expressing contempt for female teachers. He constantly misbehaves, whispering, making faces, and mocking her instruction. Anne attempts to win his affection through patience and gentleness, but Anthony remains unimpressed and resistant. His antagonism reaches a climax when he secretly places a live mouse in Anne's desk drawer. After being caught and openly confessing with insolence, Anne loses her temper and chastises him with her pointer. Following this punishment, Anthony's attitude changes significantly; he begins showing respect for Anne, even offering to carry her books, and admits that her whipping was as good as a man's.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P46](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0046), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 c5 P27](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0027), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005), [v2 c12 P23](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0023), [v2 c12 P30](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0030), [v2 c12 P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033), [v2 c12 P49](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0049), [v2 c12 P52](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0052)_
